question: As of July 2022, who is the highest wicket-taker in the history of the ICC Women's Cricket World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jhulan Goswami**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jhulan Goswami** holds the record for being the highest wicket-taker in the history of the ICC Women's World Cup as of the 2022 tournament.
 
• She is a prominent Indian cricketer known for her fast bowling and **has been a key player for the Indian women's cricket team.**
 
• Jhulan Goswami **has been a part of multiple World Cup campaigns **and has consistently performed at the highest level, earning her this distinguished record.
 
• Her achievement highlights her significant contribution to women's cricket and her status as one of the greatest bowlers in the history of the sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jhulan Goswami** made her debut for the Indian women's cricket team in 2002 and has since become a leading figure in women's cricket globally.
 
• She has received numerous awards and accolades, including the ICC Women's Player of the Year in 2007.
 
• In addition to her World Cup achievements, she has also been a part of several other international tournaments, contributing significantly to the team's success.
 
• Jhulan Goswami's dedication and performance have inspired many young girls to take up cricket and pursue their dreams in sports.
